items.summary: Recommendation: retain the implementation and financial-claim gates; approve only the bounded Save Us Farms public-surface inspection. Reject revenue, contribution-margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal-lift, forecast, and budget-exposure claims this cycle. Amazon data for 2026-09-21 reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, but all commission is on aggregate tracking_id other; site-attributed income is $0, so no site revenue or margin claim is supported. AI usage for 2026-10-01 is $34.69846565 across 223 calls and 20 observed sites versus 38 expected, with 3 errors. Contribution margin is not calculable because revenue and AI spend are not period-aligned, AI allocation is incomplete, infrastructure/domain costs and budgets are absent, and the aggregate commission cannot be assigned. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because the 30-day outcome deltas cannot be causally matched to one-day AI spend or an experiment treatment. Minimum measurement: period-aligned site/content revenue by registered tracking ID; AI and infrastructure/domain cost allocation by site and work item; complete fleet cost and budget limits; and treatment/control exposure with pre/post outcomes. SEO totals of 14,898 impressions, 152 clicks, 1,028 sessions, and 17 conversions are activity metrics, not revenue proof. Retain the 2026-10-02T12:00Z capacity and repair gate; release at most one candidate only after all evidence gates pass.
